name: MaxCyte, Inc.

result.revenue: MaxCyte, Inc. 2026年Q3營業收入為0.10億美元。
result.eps: MaxCyte, Inc. 2026年Q3每股盈餘（EPS）為-0.05美元，本期處於虧損狀態。
result.margins: MaxCyte, Inc. 2026年Q3營業毛利為0.08億美元，毛利率為80.0%。營業利益為-0.06億美元，營業利益率為-60.0%。本期淨利為-0.05億美元，淨利率為-50.0%，顯示公司目前仍處於營業虧損與淨損狀態。
result.guidance: 公司調高 2026 全年總營收財測至至少 34.5 億美元，反映預期全年營收將恢復成長。
result.outlook: MaxCyte, Inc. 2026年Q3營業收入為0.10億美元，毛利率維持在80.0%的高水準。然而，營業利益率為-60.0%，淨利率為-50.0%，每股盈餘（EPS）為-0.05美元，顯示公司在創造營收的同時仍伴隨顯著的本期虧損。

result.keyPoints:

result.guidanceOfficial: Excluding the impact of the Akron acquisition, full year revenue is now expected to be at least 3,450 萬美元, consisting of: o Core revenue of approximately 2,800 萬美元. o SPL Program-related revenue of at least 650 萬美元 for the year; SPL Program-related revenue guidance includes both revenue of approximately 400 萬美元 from milestone payments and at least 250 萬美元 from commercial royalties.
result.segments:
• Reports total revenue of 1,020 萬美元 for the third quarter of 2026, including 820 萬美元 of core revenue and 200 萬美元 of SPL Program-related revenue
• Core business revenue of 820 萬美元 in the third quarter of 2026, an increase of 27% over the third quarter of 2025.
• Strategic Platform License (SPL) Program-related revenue was 200 萬美元 for the third quarter of 2026, compared to 40 萬美元 in the third quarter of 2025.
